(1) microtubules are involved in endocrine signaling in PC; (2) taxanes and vinca alkaloids modulate endocrine receptor signaling through microtubule-mediated mechanisms; (3) microtubule-associated proteins (MAPs) are involved in the modulation of endocrine receptor signaling; and (4) MAPs are potential therapeutic targets for PC.

(1) microtubule targeting agents inhibit prostate cancer cell proliferation by disrupting microtubule dynamics and by impairing endocrine signaling pathways, and (2) microtubules are emerging as key regulators of prostate cancer cell survival and proliferation, and thus, they may serve as novel targets for prostate cancer therapies.
